title: give the UI pass a scroll-sweep check that pages to the end and back at several heights and asserts every line appears

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261122-081958-ba4a, project ork, item S401:

give the UI pass a scroll-sweep check that pages to the end and back at several heights and asserts every line appears

Evidence: page up from the last page skips a line at 80x16; 80x24 has only two pages, so the slice tests miss it
